effective_target.statement: For BTRL with T>=1,proper closed lambda_t-strongly convex cumulative G_t,lambda_t>0,finite feasible played/comparator values and actual minimizers x_t, define ghost x_(T+1)=x_T. Prove R_T(u)<=psi_T(u)-psi1(x1)-sum_(t<T)lambda_t||x_t-x_(t+1)||^2/2+sum_(t<T)(psi_t(x_(t+1))-psi_(t+1)(x_(t+1))). Optional stronger endpoint is-lambda_T||u-x_T||^2/2. Original Algorithm15.9 defines no x_(T+1); repeating last loss gives checked0<=-1/36 and is not accepted.

proof.interpretation: For an actual feasible run the two sums end before T; the sharp bound also subtracts the terminal comparator penalty. With a single round both sums are empty. The separate attainment result derives the unique feasible minimizer of each round from the carrier-relative hypotheses and positive curvature, in the specified norm. The archival statement with an undefined next iterate is retained.
examples: Repeated-last construction yields the false bound 0 <= -1/36.
Two rounds yield movement -1/2, drift -2, terminal penalty -4, sharp bound -7 and weak bound -3.
Further canaries separate constrained and ambient optima and transfer relative closedness on an open carrier.
